item.title: Windows Deployment of Ollama Troubleshooting: GitHub Download Failure, Local Network Access, OLLAMA_HOST
item.description: Three real issues encountered when deploying Ollama on Windows: download failure due to domestic network, default listening only on loopback, and OLLAMA_HOST settings not being recognized after service restart.
